statement: Epoch AI estimates that running the projected 2027 agent population at modest utilization would imply $2.6-5.3 trillion a year of API-equivalent spending, far above the roughly $1 trillion of developer revenue projected by end-2027.
why: If the compute being built can only be monetized at a fraction of its API-equivalent cost, the revenue base supporting future accelerator orders is thinner than the hardware ramp implies.

impact.mechanism: A gap between implied inference spending and realistic developer revenue constrains API monetization, which is the cash flow that ultimately funds GPU purchases.

confidence.basis: Scenario arithmetic from a single secondary publisher resting on utilization and efficiency assumptions that the report itself spans across a 24 million to 24 billion worker range.

dispersion: Implied API-equivalent spend $2.6-5.3 trillion a year against roughly $1 trillion of projected developer revenue by end-2027.
entity: multi (AI chip supply / HBM-constrained hardware, frontier and open models)
